items.heading: Njegusi Prsut and Cheese
details: Key ingredients: cured ham, cheese, olives
Slice cured Njegusi-style ham thinly.
Arrange with slices of local hard cheese.
Add a handful of olives and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve as a simple, rustic starter.

items.heading: Kacamak
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, potato, cheese, cream
Boil potato until soft, then mash roughly.
Whisk in corn meal gradually, cooking until thick.
Stir in cheese and cream until melted through.
Serve warm as a hearty, creamy side dish.
